name: open-science
tagline_zh: 厌倦了云端黑箱？本地优先、模型自由，Tauri+MCP 打造你的专属科研工作台。开源替代 Claude Scien。
tagline_en: Tired of cloud black-boxes? Local-first, model-agnostic research desktop. Open-source Claude Science alternative.
desc_en: Open Science Desktop — local-first, model-agnostic AI research workbench for macOS, Windows & Linux. Open-source Claude Science desktop alternative built on Tauri + MCP + agent skills.
why_zh: 同类工具锁死模型或云端，它却把 MCP 和技能包焊进本地，换模型不换工作台，这才是真·开源科研底座。
why_en: Unlike locked-in cloud tools, it welds MCP & skills into a local core—swap models, keep your workbench. Truly open research base.
